audience: schedulers and managers of shift-based teams that run their rota and time clock in Aladtec

useCases.title: See who is on shift and who is clocked in now
useCases.text: List the members scheduled right now, with their schedule and position. Then list the members who are clocked in at this moment.

useCases.title: Find open shifts that need cover this week
useCases.text: List the open time in a date range, where no member is scheduled. Check the availability of members for those hours and read the shift labels to name each shift.

useCases.title: Review time off requests that are still pending
useCases.text: List the time off requests in a range and include the pending ones. Check the availability of the members for those dates.

useCases.title: Prepare payroll from time clock records
useCases.text: List the time clock records for a pay period and the paycodes that apply to them. Run the payroll report export and pass the next token to read every page.

useCases.title: Check accrual balances and work group rules
useCases.text: List the accrual banks and the hours in each bank for a list of members. Read the work groups to see the scheduling and overtime rules for them.
